annotations.title: Find gifts for a list of people

description: Get gift ideas for several people in one call: 5 personalized ideas for each of 2 to 10 people, each idea with a reason it fits and within the budget, plus a giftgenius.io link per person that opens that person's ideas (these and more) with photos and where to buy them. For a holiday list, a family or a team. Pass one entry per person with every detail you already know; only the relationship is required for each. People are identified by their position in the list, not by name.

budget.description: Price per gift for everyone on the list: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

people.description: The 2 to 10 people to find gifts for, one entry each, without their names. Results come back in the same order.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

budget.description: Price per gift for this person, when it differs from the budget for the list.

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

name: find_gifts_for_list

gift_list_url.description: The gift list page on giftgenius.io, where a list of people can be typed or pasted, one per line.

error.description: Set when no ideas came back for this person.

finder_url.description: The same search for this person on giftgenius.io, for the user to refine or get more ideas.

why.description: Why this recipient will love it, addressed to the giver.

list_url.description: This person's ideas on giftgenius.io, these and the rest found for them, with photos and where to buy each one.

position.description: 1 for the first person passed, 2 for the second, and so on.

who.description: The kind of person, from the relationship and age passed, e.g. "Kid, age 12".

title: Find gifts for a list of people
